source.title: DepEd Kindergarten Curriculum Guide, May 2016
source.framework: National Early Learning Framework / developmental-domain alignment
source.mapping_level: Domain-level alignment; no claim of official endorsement or exact ELDS indicator equivalence

status: Locally authored classroom/home planning suggestions; teacher review required
trigger: PRE domain scaled score <=6 OR explicitly marked PRE DI-KAYA items
tier_rule: Local support tiers: scaled <=3 Delay, 4..6 Slight Delay, >=7 Average; not a diagnosis

GM.name: Gross Motor
GM.curriculum_area: Physical Health and Motor Development: gross motor
GM.goal: Move with balance and coordinated whole-body actions
GM.classroom: Model a safe floor-level path with walking, stepping and gentle ball rolling; practise one movement at a time.
GM.home: Play a supervised follow-the-leader walking and ball-rolling game in a clear space.
GM.observation: Record balance, coordination and prompts needed for the selected checklist movement.

Delay.practice: Brief supported practice daily, one achievable step at a time
Delay.scaffolding: Model, practise together, then fade assistance gradually
Delay.classroom_activity: Model a safe floor-level path with walking, stepping and gentle ball rolling; practise one movement at a time.
Delay.home_activity: Play a supervised follow-the-leader walking and ball-rolling game in a clear space.
Delay.success_check: Record balance, coordination and prompts needed for the selected checklist movement.

Slight Delay.practice: Brief small-group or paired practice several times each week
Slight Delay.scaffolding: Offer a cue, allow independent attempts, and reduce prompts
Slight Delay.classroom_activity: Model a safe floor-level path with walking, stepping and gentle ball rolling; practise one movement at a time.
Slight Delay.home_activity: Play a supervised follow-the-leader walking and ball-rolling game in a clear space.
Slight Delay.success_check: Record balance, coordination and prompts needed for the selected checklist movement.

Average.practice: Embed practice in ordinary play and familiar routines
Average.scaffolding: Offer independent practice and a small extension when ready
Average.classroom_activity: Model a safe floor-level path with walking, stepping and gentle ball rolling; practise one movement at a time.
Average.home_activity: Play a supervised follow-the-leader walking and ball-rolling game in a clear space.
Average.success_check: Record balance, coordination and prompts needed for the selected checklist movement.

FM.name: Fine Motor
FM.curriculum_area: Physical Health and Motor Development: fine motor; creative expression
FM.goal: Use hands together and control small-object and drawing movements
FM.classroom: Offer large blocks, dough squeezing and short drawing strokes; model grip without forcing handedness.
FM.home: Make dough shapes and stack large safe household objects with adult supervision.
FM.observation: Record grasp, bilateral hand use and independence on the selected item.

SH.name: Self-Help
SH.curriculum_area: Physical Health and Motor Development: personal care and safety
SH.goal: Complete familiar personal-care steps with growing independence
SH.classroom: Use a picture sequence to rehearse handwashing, putting materials away or managing a simple fastening.
SH.home: Let the child practise one familiar dressing or handwashing step, then gradually reduce adult prompts.
SH.observation: Record which routine steps are independent and which require a cue.

RL.name: Receptive Language
RL.curriculum_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: listening comprehension
RL.goal: Understand familiar spoken directions in the child's strongest language
RL.classroom: Pair a short spoken direction with a gesture and object; check understanding before adding another step.
RL.home: Play a simple find-and-place game with familiar objects and short directions in the home language.
RL.observation: Record correct responses, direction length and whether visual cues were needed.

EL.name: Expressive Language
EL.curriculum_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: oral expression
EL.goal: Communicate needs and describe familiar experiences
EL.classroom: Use picture talk and pretend play; allow response time and expand the child's own words into a short phrase.
EL.home: Talk together about a familiar picture or daily event and model a short phrase without demanding repetition.
EL.observation: Record spontaneous words, phrases or accessible communication used for the selected skill.

C.name: Cognitive
C.curriculum_area: Mathematics; Understanding the Physical and Natural Environment
C.goal: Compare, remember and solve simple problems using concrete objects
C.classroom: Use familiar objects for matching, sorting and simple counting games; demonstrate one comparison first.
C.home: Sort safe household objects by one visible property and discuss how they match.
C.observation: Record correct matches, explanations and prompts required for the chosen checklist skill.

SE.name: Socio-Emotional
SE.goal: Recognize feelings and participate in supportive social routines
SE.classroom: Use puppets to name feelings and rehearse a short turn-taking game with a predictable cue.
SE.home: Name feelings during a calm shared activity and practise asking for a turn with a trusted adult.
SE.observation: Record participation, communication of feelings and support required during turn-taking.
